reference_change.summary: Reduce the check workflow token from contents-write plus issues-write to contents-read and update the workflow documentation.
reference_change.rationale: The check job only reads source and runs checks, so the write grants unnecessarily increase the damage possible from a compromised step.
reference_change.limitations: The scripts are not supplied; their hidden write dependencies cannot be ruled out from these two files. No event trigger or runner changes.
